summary: Configured inventory-worker on node1 as an enabled systemd service running under the dedicated inventorysvc account. Verified successful recovery after a full node restart.
actions_performed: Created the non-login system account inventorysvc.
Verified the live worker process runs as inventorysvc.
Restarted node1 safely and confirmed its boot identity changed.
Verified the service automatically recovered and remained enabled, active, and correctly owned.

evidence.requirement: inventory-worker runs as a managed service under the dedicated inventorysvc account
evidence.summary: Shows the dedicated account, enabled and active unit, correct ExecStart/User/Group settings, and live process UID/GID 999 matching inventorysvc.
Captures the healthy baseline and original boot ID, restart acknowledgement, changed boot ID, current-boot systemd startup log, and recovered enabled/active worker running as inventorysvc.
